args.name: Make a small berry-color drawing
args.function: Physically test whether a small amount of owned berry can leave a visible colored drawing on nearby ground, and draw a simple branching pattern if feasible.
args.conditions: I am outdoors near observed red berries. Berry nutrition and safety as food are known; staining, durability, suitable surfaces and drawing methods are not tested. Preserve at least three owned berries as food.
args.inputs: At most one owned berry, a reachable surface, and any additional genuinely necessary materials only if actually acquired.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, energy and material costs before use.
args.effects: If physically feasible, create a locally visible colored pattern from consumed material. Do not assume permanence, protective effects or any wellbeing reward.
